title: Bright + Stylish Rooftop with firepit!
description:
Welcome to The Overlook Nashville! Enjoy sweeping skyline views from your private rooftop patio featuring cushioned seating and a fire pit. Minutes from Broadway’s live music, Germantown dining, Topgolf, Fat Bottom Brewing, SandBar, and Ted Rhodes Golf Club. BetterBNB guests get exclusive VIP discounts on luxury airport chauffeurs and pontoon rentals on Percy Priest & Old Hickory Lakes. Includes 3 bedrooms, 3 baths, full kitchen, and 2-car garage for the ultimate Music City stay!

The space
Welcome to The Overlook Nashville Enjoy your private rooftop patio with cushioned seating, a fire pit, and sweeping skyline views. Step out to Broadway’s live music and honky-tonk bars, explore Germantown’s trendy eateries, perfect your swing at Topgolf, savor craft brews at Fat Bottom Brewing, enjoy cocktails at SandBar Nashville, or tee off at Ted Rhodes Golf Club. The Overlook Nashville offers the perfect mix of style, comfort, and city excitement for an unforgettable stay.

Guest access
Each property is equipped with a Yale smart lock—you’ll receive a personalized entry code in your check-in instructions prior to arrival. No keys to keep track of, and easy self check-in any time after 4 PM.

Other things to note
We’d love to host you, whether you’re visiting for a single night, a month, or even up to six months. At BetterBNB, our mission is to provide a clean, comfortable, and welcoming home where every guest feels cared for.

Your safety and comfort are our top priorities. We take pride in creating a space where you can relax, recharge, and feel at ease during your time in Nashville. Thank you for trusting us with your stay—we look forward to making your experience smooth, stress-free, and memorable.
